question: At the delayed-start terminal base, is the missing causal CE gain primarily limited by frame radius, residual direction error, both, or loss of frozen-endpoint portability?

protocol.model_base: delayed-start terminal checkpoint with every non-frame tensor held bitwise fixed

variants.endpoint_full_radius: step-120 frozen-endpoint coordinates transplanted without rescaling
variants.endpoint_direction_native_radius: each endpoint coordinate group rescaled by one global group scalar to the native delayed group Frobenius norm
variants.native_direction_endpoint_radius: each native delayed coordinate group rescaled by one global group scalar to the endpoint group Frobenius norm

protocol.rescaling_scope: one scalar per frame family across all 12 layers; no per-layer fitting, interpolation search, optimization, or validation selection
protocol.precision: BF16 autocast on PRO6 GPU0 with cached materialized bases

metrics.primary: mean CE gain relative to native_delayed across the two frozen windows

decision_rule.endpoint_not_portable: endpoint_full_radius mean gain below 0.005 or negative on either window
decision_rule.amplitude_dominates: endpoint_full_radius is portable; native_direction_endpoint_radius clears the gain and fraction thresholds; endpoint_direction_native_radius does not
decision_rule.direction_dominates: endpoint_full_radius is portable; endpoint_direction_native_radius clears the gain and fraction thresholds; native_direction_endpoint_radius does not
decision_rule.both_direction_and_radius_matter: endpoint_full_radius is portable and neither controlled variant clears both thresholds
decision_rule.both_controlled_variants_sufficient: endpoint_full_radius is portable and both controlled variants clear both thresholds

next_action_binding.amplitude_dominates: design one causal coordinate-trust/radial-transport mechanism; do not sweep scalar learning rates
next_action_binding.direction_dominates: design one target-stabilized or transported-gradient learner; do not add radius
next_action_binding.both_direction_and_radius_matter: design one two-timescale transported frame learner that controls both target drift and trust radius
next_action_binding.endpoint_not_portable: close this endpoint-frame route and return to c_proj generator structure
